summary: End-to-end verification of the Phase-1 Candy-Crush-grade Games overhaul (web only). Backend cover_image contract passes 6/6 pytest tests (public /api/games list exposes cover_image on every game; postmeplex-match carries a persistent https cover; PUT /api/admin/games/{id} requires auth; https URL persists; empty string clears; non-https is cleared). Frontend: Games LIST at /games renders the new rich cards — the postmeplex-match card (data-testid=game-card-postmeplex-match) shows a full-bleed cover IMAGE with the title overlaid and a '30 levels' Trophy badge; Viking Coin Master and PostMePlex Spin show emoji+gradient fallbacks with 'Spin & Raid' badges and Play affordances. Full-screen immersive shell works on /games/postmeplex-match: MAP (data-testid=game-map) renders the saga nodes (saga-map + level-node-1 unlocked, further levels locked) over the custom candy backdrop with the X exit (game-exit). Tapping level-node-1 opens the full-screen INTRO (data-testid=level-intro) with 'Level 1', '28 Moves', 'Target 1,500' and a Start button (level-start-btn). Start opens the full-screen PLAY (data-testid=match3-board) with HUD (hud-moves=28, hud-score=0), full booster bar (booster-shuffle×3, booster-hammer/Smash×3, booster-moves/+5 Moves×2), the glossy Candy-Crush candies rendered on a 560px-wide board centered on desktop, and the persistent game-exit. EXIT behavior verified: play->map goes back to map, map->/games returns to Games list. Mobile viewport (390x844): /games/postmeplex-match map renders with no horizontal overflow (document.documentElement.scrollWidth == window.innerWidth == 390) and game-exit visible. Admin cover editor UI at /admin/games is present per game: cover-editor-postmeplex-match + cover-upload-postmeplex-match + cover-clear-postmeplex-match all rendered. studio-ready and studio-cover-upload are correctly ABSENT (gated behind a Sage-produced spec; not triggered per credit constraint — no Sage/LLM endpoints were called).
critical_code_review_comments: GameMap.jsx GameScreen correctly centralizes the full-screen shell with persistent exit (data-testid=game-exit) across map/intro/play/result phases — exit routing is correct: map->/games, else ->map. Clean implementation.

backend/routes/games.py _clean_cover_image is tight (https-only + <=1000 chars, returns None otherwise). Non-https silently clears rather than 400ing — intentional UX choice (empty-string = explicit clear); acceptable but worth documenting on PUT body schema for future callers.

Games.jsx GameCard uses background-image via inline style with cover_image URL directly — fine, but no onError handling for broken Cloudinary URLs; if a cover 404s, the card falls back to blank art (no emoji) because hasImg is truthy. Minor polish: optionally detect image load failure and swap to emoji fallback.

Non-blocking: match3 cells don't use a cell-<r>-<c> data-testid pattern on the piece elements (my swap automation couldn't locate them), so e2e swap scoring couldn't be programmatically verified. The engine is explicitly unchanged this round and the HUD + boosters + board visually render correctly in the screenshot. Consider adding a stable testid pattern like match3-cell-<r>-<c> for future regression tests.

If a future task needs programmatic swap verification, inspect /app/frontend/src/components/Match3Board.jsx or /app/frontend/src/games/match3.js for the actual piece testid pattern (or ask main agent to add match3-cell-<r>-<c>). Everything else in the overhaul (list cards, immersive map/intro/play, boosters, exit routing, mobile overflow, admin cover editor, backend cover_image CRUD) is confirmed working. Avoid Sage/AI studio endpoints — paid LLM.
